footnotes: Since 2009, businesses that generate a large amount of food waste (food-related businesses that generated 100 tons or more of food waste, etc. in the previous fiscal year) are required to report the amount of food waste, etc. generated and the status of recycling of resources from wasted food to the competent minister every fiscal year. As Japan uses the results of this report to calculate the amount of food waste, the amount of business-related food waste has been included since 2009.
